statement: A ComponentizeJS-built component whose generated entrypoint statically imports an unmodified lagrange.service.js, the guest-safe authoring library, and a local handler module — with no Function.toString or source rewriting — exports the existing service-cell world, answers two HTTP routes by method+path dispatch inside handle-request, and routes a handler's call(opRef) to the canonical call-binding host import, proven by jco instantiation against captured host fakes.

constraints.statement: If this Quest changes source code, spawn a subagent verifier before audit and git handoff, then record a Solver finding with evidence subagent:<id>.

The generated entrypoint imports developer modules as ES modules; Function.toString, source transformation, or bundler rewriting of developer code is prohibited. A spike that only passes with rewriting fails the quest rather than amending it.
Spike artifacts live under test fixtures; no src/authoring or src/service production module is created by this Quest.
